senses.zh_definition: 雷蒙德：男性人名，属于专有名词。
senses.en_definition: A masculine given name of Germanic origin.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas lelaki yang berasal daripada tradisi penamaan Germanik.
senses.nuances: 正文通常写作 Raymond。IPA 为常见英语读法，具体读音以本人习惯为准。输入未提供 DBP 定义、音节划分或 Jawi 拼写，因此保留缺失值；本条马来文释义为编写释义，未经核实为 DBP 官方释义。搭配为人名使用示例，不代表语料频率统计。

etymology.historical_story: Raymond developed from the Germanic name Raginmund, whose elements concern counsel and protection. The Normans introduced a form of the name into England. Its history belongs to personal naming: using Raymond in a Malay sentence identifies a person rather than creating a Malay word meaning counsel or protection. [Source: Behind the Name](https://www.behindthename.com/name/raymond).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Raymond 与具体人物绑定：Encik Raymond＝雷蒙德先生。名字整体记忆，不把历史词源当作现代词义。
